set.body:
Outcome: additive evidence-qualified claim assessment with controlled same-event contrasts, preserving existing event alignment and outputs.
Scope: distinguish recall noncommitment, extraction/reference uncertainty, source evidence absence, support and explicit counterevidence; preserve conflicts and fixed-population coverage. New report does not claim calibrated veridicality or improved corpus retrieval.
Acceptance: runnable controlled contrasts for paraphrase, partial false memory, explicit negation, missing source/recall extraction, modality/disjunction, wrong event and contradictory sources; invariant source alignment; exact-SHA independent review and scoped portable tests plus mutation witness.
Parent empirical accuracy acceptance remains open. Existing Sherlock data and caption experiments remain local development evidence. Owner authorized implementation in chat 2026-10-21.
Next action: settle minimal evidence contract with independent reviewer, implement in standalone checkout, produce a readable report and preserve receipts.
set.title: Evidence-qualified claim assessment without changing event alignment
